title: A Physics-Informed B-Spline Framework for Continuous Approximation of Flow Data
summary: Continuous approximations of flow data are useful for downstream analysis, differentiation, and visualization, but purely data-driven reconstructions do not, in general, preserve the governing physics. This limitation becomes particularly important when input data are physically inconsistent, whether due to low-fidelity discretizations or unmodeled discrepancies. In such cases, reconstructed fields may exhibit inaccurate PDE residuals, violated balance laws, or unreliable derived quantities.
